question: What is the higher significance of the constant washing of the mouth?
premises: Washing of the mouth is performed always
It is described as having gone upward
inference: The constant washing of the mouth is understood as an upward movement toward Brahman.
uncertainties: The ritual and symbolic meaning of ūrddha gatam is open to interpretation.
plain_english: O beloved, the constant washing of the mouth is the upward movement toward Brahman.
